description.value: Parallel 49 Brewing is a Vancouver craft brewery founded in 2012, recognised as one of BC's early leaders in the craft beer movement. Their on-site Street Kitchen is billed as one of BC's largest craft brewery restaurants, with 40+ beers on tap and a fully stocked indoor food truck concept. An on-site retail beer store carries the full range of releases, making it a practical stop for cyclists looking to resupply with local craft beer.
